NVIDIA — Global GSI Lead, Healthcare and Life Sciences Ecosystem

Dear Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the Global GSI Lead role in Healthcare and Life Sciences. My healthcare AI work spans clinical, research, and regulatory environments. At the TReNDS Center, I served as tech lead for COINSTAC, a federated neuroimaging and genomics research platform, where I built GPU compute infrastructure for deep learning workloads and co-authored research published in Frontiers in Neuroinformatics. Through Hyperbloom, the consulting firm I founded and grew to $1.4M ARR, I architected disaster recovery for clinical trial software supporting 10,000+ research sites across 45 countries and designed a life science data exchange built for HIPAA, GDPR, HL7, and CDISC interoperability. At Slalom, I delivered behavioral health demand forecasting across dozens of Georgia facilities and a healthcare application that generated over $2M in consulting revenue.

On the partner operating model: at AWS, I managed a portfolio of 10+ enterprise accounts as an AI/ML Solutions Architect while partnering with Deloitte and Accenture. I built C-suite relationships, defined joint technical and business strategies, and worked alongside sales teams to drive cloud AI adoption and revenue. At Slalom, I was on the consulting side — partnering with Microsoft Azure to deliver joint healthcare and public sector solutions and growing the firm's AI practice through workshops and sales support. At Hyperbloom, I built the go-to-market strategy from scratch, leading teams of sales coordinators, account managers, and solutions architects through the full sales cycle while establishing partnerships with technology vendors and research organizations.

This role interests me because it sits at the intersection of healthcare AI, partner ecosystems, and go-to-market execution. I'd bring domain credibility earned through hands-on technical delivery and practical experience navigating partner relationships from both the vendor and consulting sides.
